name: modes
description: SIBOL: an offline-first Local AI math tutor for Filipino Grade 4-6 learners (DepEd MATATAG). Gemma 4 E2B runs on a laptop, not the cloud. English, Tagalog, Taglish. Three learning modes: Kalma, Pakinig, Hakbang. AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026.

paragraphs: An offline-first Local AI math companion for Filipino Grade 4 to 6 learners (DepEd MATATAG curriculum). A friendly AI tutor answers a learner's question step by step in English, Tagalog or Taglish, and can read the answer aloud. The answers come from an open-source model, Gemma 4 E2B, running on the team's own laptop (an "edge" setup), not from a cloud AI API.

This repository was built for the AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026 (theme: Local AI). Landing page: sibol-landing-ph.vercel.app (source: public/landing.html, also served by the app at /landing.html; it shows the three learning modes and who each is designed for, and its buttons open the live app). Demo video: YouTube. Posts: X, LinkedIn.
features: No cloud AI API in the tutor path. With the edge backend on, a question is answered by Gemma 4 E2B served by LM Studio on a machine the team controls.
No per-question cost. Inference uses the laptop's own hardware.
Works with the laptop offline. On the laptop itself, open the app at the model and the app both run with the network off.
Child data stays on the team's machine for tutor questions. There are no accounts, and the learner's progress is stored on their own device (IndexedDB).
Phones need a connection to reach the laptop. The demo uses an ngrok tunnel, so a phone needs internet to talk to the laptop. Without it the app falls back to bundled explanations.
